title: No Caves and Ravines
description: This Project Removes all of Caves and Ravines In your World. Good luck :)
body:
# No Caves

## What it Does?

This project removes all of caves spawning in your world. Perfect for Survival, Hardcore Players to make their life worse.

## Compability?

This project is maked for 1.21 but it should work for  almost every version
